verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents a hosted feedback portal with in-app widgets, so there is a portal for users to be directed to. However, the evidence never describes a portal URL, a shareable or embeddable link, custom-domain portal links, or authenticated deep-linking from a host product. Missing for 10: documentation of portal URLs or link setup, an SSO or identified-user link flow, deep links to specific boards or posts, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a link in my product that directs users to the feedback portal

citations.quote: Centralize insights to a single source of truth with a feedback portal, in-app widgets, and integrations.
Let users vote on each other's ideas & show a public roadmap.
